The Lobster — Depth's Cave mini-boss grown to a boiler-sized cave lobster; arena = the Cathedral until tide 12, then any hall it can reach by slipstream (it rides E and F).
HP 15,000 (x1.08 per tide); front shell halves damage; weak point: the underside, exposed 3 s when it Rears. It Rears when the crystal coral rings (a shot cluster) or after taking 800 damage in 5 s.
Phase 1 (100-60%): Crush (claw grab: destroys a Shell Shield, holds 2 s), Sweep (knockback), Clack (stun 1 s in 10 m, 10 noise). Patrols the Cathedral floor; ignores divers on the overlooks.
Phase 2 (60-30%): moves onto the walls and ceiling (upside-down, hard to hit); Clack now drops one stalactite per use on a marked square; summons 4 Troglobite Crabs from the crystal.

Phase 3 (30-0%): rides slipstream E backward into the Dynamo Sump and cuts the power (the Forge and traps go dark until the switch is reset); its Clack drops 3 stalactites; Rear only from coral rings.

Arena rules: ringing the coral costs a shot and 6 noise but forces a Rear; the overlook drops let divers reset by falling to the Sump (the Lobster follows by slipstream in 20 s); ink caps in the Cathedral blind it 5 s.

Kill reward: 1,500 base scrip x tide, a Locker weapon each, and the expedition's key (opens the Lantern Cache's locked crate: a free wonder weapon). Reforms in the Cathedral after 6 minutes at 50% HP.
